lazy_vulkan.use: Allocator mechanism adapted into yakui-vulkan; no runtime renderer dependency.

scope: Rendering quality and common slider examples; no expansion of prototype scope.
live_check: Retina WGPU window inspected in light/dark themes; pointer drag visibly moved the thumb and retained its value through theme switching.

capture_conditions.browser_css: Pinned Nova plus packages/shadcn/src/tailwind.css; actual unmodified upstream examples.

known_differences: Thumbs share one retained widget with internal keyboard navigation; distinct platform accessibility nodes are not implemented.
Native keyboard focus deliberately keeps a visible thumb ring; the pinned browser example focuses its hidden input without styling the outer thumb.
The native input band is 20px across around the 4px visible track. Gallery vertical spacing compensates for this input padding.
Multiple/controlled values use the public range/value APIs; separate upstream multiple/controlled demos and RTL composition are not ported.
commands: python3 tools/visual.py --component slider --variants default range vertical disabled --states default --scale-factor 2 --output visual/slider/retina
historical_evidence: Earlier captures retain their original single-sample renderer and reference harness conditions. They have not been silently replaced or recertified.
